13: Paon founded by Data East staff (same as 1 but object_type group of people vs organization). Equivalent content.

14: publisher (Glory of Heracles, Nintendo) no qualifiers. This is less specific than 2 (which includes time and region). Are they equivalent? 2 says publisher Nintendo at point in time May 22 2008 region Japan. 14 says publisher Nintendo (no qualifiers). The paragraph: "published by Nintendo in Japan on May 22, 2008". So 14 missing qualifiers but still true. However equivalence test requires same complete proposition. 14 lacks time and region qualifiers, so it's a weaker assertion. Could 2 be true while 14 false? If Nintendo published the game at a different time? Actually 14 asserts Nintendo is the publisher (generally). That is true regardless of time/region. 2 asserts Nintendo was the publisher at that specific time and region. Both can be true simultaneously. Could 2 be true while 14 false? If Nintendo was not the publisher at all, then 2 would be false. So 2 true implies 14 true? Not necessarily: if Nintendo published only in Japan on that date, still Nintendo is publisher overall, so 14 true. So 2 entails 14, but not vice versa. Not equivalent. So separate groups.

15: release date (Glory of Heracles, 22 May 2008) qualifier location Japan. Equivalent to 10? 10: date of release May 22 2008 region Japan. Relation names differ: "date of release" vs "release date". Should be considered same proposition? Yes synonyms. Qualifier "location" vs "region". Equivalent. So 10 and 15 are duplicates. Also 3 is date of publication May 22 2008 region Japan. Publication vs release? In paragraph: "published by Nintendo in Japan on May 22, 2008". That's publication date, not release date? Actually "published" could be release. However relation difference may be considered equivalent? The rule: synonyms allowed. "date of publication" vs "date of release" maybe not exact synonyms. Usually publication date is the same as release date for video games. Could treat as equivalent? Need careful. The test: same complete proposition. I'd say they are equivalent. But there is also qualifier region/location same. So 3,10,15 could be same group. Could be considered equivalent because the event already includes year. The qualifier is redundant. So 8 and 18 could be duplicates. 27 uses "revealed at" not same relation. So separate.

payload.title: Glory of Heracles
payload.paragraph_text: Glory of Heracles is a 2008 Japanese role-playing video game developed by Paon (a company founded by the Data East staff) and published by Nintendo in Japan on May 22, 2008 for the Nintendo DS. It is the sixth game of the "Glory of Heracles" series. It was revealed at Electronic Entertainment Expo 2009 that this game would be the first in the series to be released outside Japan, which was later released in North America on January 18, 2010.
